entries.evidence: The retained source is the coherent VC7 CRT stream-pool scan under the CRT's /O1 /Gy recipe. Target and base have the same 290-byte text and the same resolved SEH funclet destination, but the base carries 21 relocations while January carries 22: the local call is encoded directly instead of through a compiler-generated relocation against __getstream plus an addend. This is not semantically credited because a relocation entry is absent, even though masking relocation fields makes the bytes identical. Sixteen compiler-flag variants and three locally distinct VC7 suites reproduce the same compiler-internal SEH-label choice. No assembly, volatile access, fake dependency, dead branch, or compiler-control source shaping is retained. Reopen only for authentic CRT source/compiler provenance or a natural source lever that emits the missing relocation.

Authenticated original-assembly recovery admitted under the 2026-08-31 house rule that helper and math functions may sparingly use inline assembly. Intel Application Note AP-930 (June 1999, order 245045-001) publishes the matching PIII_Mult00_3x3_3x3 kernel as naked hand-written SSE assembly; January adapts that schedule for the 4x3 position row. A user-supplied 2026-08-31 discussion adds independent cross-platform testimony from Aerocatia: Halo PC selects SSE, 3DNow, or apparent-C variants; the PC SSE and Xbox XBE instruction streams are the same except that Xbox leaves the final scalar scale product to x87, and the same SSE stream survives in a PC executable produced with the roughly twenty-years-newer 2020 Digsite compiler. The recovered source therefore retains the hand-scheduled SSE kernel in one __asm block and leaves result->scale = a->scale * b->scale as ordinary C. Four natural pointer locals reproduce VC7's wrapper and parameter-slot homes. The campaign compiler emits the exact 336-byte, zero-relocation target with no object splicing, alternate assembler, byte directives, or post-processing. This park is provenance accounting for admitted original assembly, not a fuzzy-codegen exception; it remains valid only while the compiled function stays exact.

Fuzzy-parked with the complete first-party Microsoft CRT implementation retained in ordinary C. XDK 3911 CodeView names d:\xbox-finalfre\private\sdktools\crt\fpw32\conv\x10fout.c, and the matching Microsoft source in xerohour/xbox_leak_may_2020 commit fd00b4b3b2abb1ea6ef9ac64b755419741a3af00 blob 7e9106227dc9543ac5bca9a216e0fdf1b0b486cc explicitly defines STRCPY as strcpy and uses it for all four special-value outputs. Under the unchanged /O1 /Gy policy, VC7 leaves two shared tail calls out of line, producing 638 bytes and 14 relocations instead of January's 631 bytes and 12. A previously reported strict-exact form replaced those calls with invented fixed-size aggregate types and assignments solely to steer code generation; it is rejected under the anti-fake rule because authoritative source proves those constructs were absent. /Oi, optimizer pragmas, forced inline, aggregate copy substitutes, assembly, volatile/register forcing, undefined behavior, fake dependencies, and nonsensical control flow are not retained. Reopen only with authenticated evidence for January's CRT intrinsic configuration or original compiler/header context that naturally lowers the four strcpy calls to the target copies.

Authenticated original Microsoft/XDK inline-assembly recovery admitted under the house rule allowing sparse evidenced assembly in helper and math functions. XDK 3911 CodeView records name fpw32\tran\i386\frnd.c, the double argument x, and the double local result; consecutive source-line records map fld x, frndint, and fstp result to three consecutive lines in the historical C source. The normal VC7 compile emits the exact 19-byte, zero-relocation January function with identical COMDAT ownership and no byte directives, object splicing, post-processing, undefined behavior, or fake C steering. This entry records admitted original assembly provenance rather than ordinary-C reconstruction credit. See docs/object_matching_logs/libcmt_frnd_obj_authenticated_asm_20260919.md.

Authenticated vendor MASM arithmetic helper: XDK 3911 libcmt.lib member has .file ..\i386\llshr.asm and Microsoft Macro Assembler 6.15.8803 CodeView identity. The project now assembles readable x86 instructions with an explicit ordinary .text SEGMENT ALIGN(16), reproducing January's 33-byte no-relocation helper and COFF flags without copying binary bytes or forcing C section metadata. Physical whole-object matching is real, but an assembly transcription matches by construction and is excluded from meaningful reconstructed-C code credit. See docs/object_matching_logs/libcmt_llshr_obj_20260923.md.
